reference_sql:
SELECT pr.promo_id, pr.promo_code
FROM promotions pr
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE ol.promo_id = pr.promo_id
    AND p.category_id = 35
)
alternatives:
SELECT promo_id, promo_code
FROM promotions
WHERE promo_id NOT IN (
  SELECT ol.promo_id
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = 35
    AND ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL
)

WITH cables_promos AS (
  -- one row per promotion that a Cables line carried
  SELECT DISTINCT ol.promo_id
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = 35
    AND ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT pr.promo_id, pr.promo_code
FROM promotions pr
LEFT JOIN cables_promos c ON c.promo_id = pr.promo_id
WHERE c.promo_id IS NULL
